lines: In māyā again the crystal-clear divisions
take māyic letter-nature — those who, attaining
mundanity in paśyantī, madhyamā, vaikharī, stand up
to the nature of external tattvas. Seen body-like,
revived by those pure contemplations — the life-replacing —
they turn vigorous, granting enjoyment and liberation. Thus,
seeing oneself as the rest of all contemplation, as the

reads_against.argmap: What happens to māyic divisions when re-quickened by pure parāmarśas? → Māyic varṇas revive under pure parāmarśa into bhoga-mokṣa-granters; the endpoint is jīvanmuktatā through nirvikalpa śāṃbhava-samāveśa.
c1_essence: Māyic divisions revive under pure contemplations into vigors granting both enjoyment and liberation — the view ends in liberated-while-living.
